message.content:
An editorial illustration shows a muscular, shirtless man from the back, positioned against a textured blue background. His head is turned slightly to the right, showing his profile. His back features deep, shadowed grooves suggesting musculature or scars. On his lower right back, a red dollar sign symbol is etched or tattooed with a dashed-line effect. A red vertical bar runs along the left edge of the frame.

The illustration contains the following text: "PERSEKONGKOLAN KARTEL AYAM" and "LOBI-LOBI KASUS NOVEL BASWEDAN" at the top. The large red word "TEMPO" is centered above the man. Below it, smaller text reads "15-21 FEBRUARI 2016". To the left of the man, white text reads: "JARINGAN MAKELAR CANGKOK GINJAL" followed by "Diperdagangkan hingga Rp 500 juta per organ, benarkah dokter RSCM terlibat?". At the bottom left, a barcode is visible next to "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273". The top left corner features a colorful graphic logo with red, yellow, and blue shapes.
